parsed.name: 视频文件帧采集源
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件视频源组件，用于从视频文件中读取并持续提供图像帧。它可连接到文件路径、在后台线程中连续抓取最新帧，并用于实验视频回放、图像处理流程测试或在没有真实相机时模拟视频输入。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software video source component that reads and serves image frames from a video file. It can connect to a file path, continuously capture frames in a background thread, and is used for experiment video playback, image-processing pipeline testing, or simulating camera input when no real camera is present.
